\chapter*{Prevalence of Diseases by Demographic Group}
\addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{Prevalence of Diseases by Demographic Group}

The table below reports the estimated percentage of a sample of 1,000,000
people affected in each demographic group: the general population (Common),
females, males, children, and older adults. Values are point-prevalence
estimates rounded from the epidemiology data presented in each chapter; 0
indicates that the condition is not normally encountered in that group, and
entries such as obstetric and gynecologic disorders apply only to females.
